外表具有野性美，有虎牙和小麦色的肌肤，一头茂密的长发总是扎成高马尾。时不时会说出冲绳方言，自称是「自分」，句尾会带上「だぞ」，口癖是「なんくるないさー！」（总会有办法的！／船到桥头自然直！）。
经常自称「完美」，各方面的实力也确实很强。有着发达的运动神经，舞蹈能力不输给真。此外还擅长做家务，料理的水平很高，即使是复杂的西餐也不在话下。

在《百万现场》和《白金星光》中，在舞台上的形象依旧强硬帅气，私下里却是可爱温顺并且容易害羞的性格。

Yuuri Shibuya (渋谷 有利 Shibuya Yūri) is the protagonist of the story. He was born in Boston, Massachusetts in the United States and grew up in Saitama, Japan. He is a high school student who enjoys baseball more than textbooks.3 The kanji Yuri's parents chose for his name Yūri means profitable, so people make fun of him by saying Shibuya Yūri, Harajuku Furi (roughly translated meaning "if Shibuya is profitable then Harajuku is unprofitable"). His mother insists that he is named Yuri because he was born in July and it has nothing to do with money or the fact that his father is a banker. In the English dub, this became the pun "Yuri is short for urine." He later finds out that Conrad inspired his mother to use the name since he mentioned while she was in labor that, where he comes from, July is called Yūri.

When Yuuri first arrives in The Demon Kingdom, he is told that he is the 27th King of the Demons. Throughout the series, he strives to create a world in which demons and humans can live together in peace, something that progresses slowly but surely as the series goes on.

Yuri easily gets caught up in his emotions, to the point he loses control of himself. He is quick to anger, and once he's angry he cannot stop himself. When he is angry or sad or feels a strong emotion his powers emerge. Yuri is a huge fan of Japanese historical dramas and so when he is in this mode he uses expressions from those dramas. Fans call this condition "Maou mode" (or emperor mode in Japanese). In the novel there is no note of his appearance changing, while in the manga and anime his eyes become slitted and his hair may grow longer.
